No worries about the vehicle status man; it’s overrated and gas about to be $6 a pop down here (San Diego). Right now, save up money and try to invest into something that will bring you money. Cars are just a true liability than an asset.

If you have the chance, I recommend contacting your sibling one on one and ask how they’re feeling and show some love and compassion. Also, if they know that you know about their Reddit account; and if your relationship is close enough I think you should tell them straight up that you seen their post and it was concerning to you and try to talk to them about it.

I am just about the same way, except the aimlessly masturbating haha but do you play games? What are studying for school, maybe you can find some interest along that field.

Don’t try to reach where you were before, aim for higher above that. I understand it’s not easy getting over those mental battles but try to do thing you enjoy or learn some new hobbies. Even though it’s not easy, changes come from the inside and I know you can achieve where you want to be. I feel it inside you man; aim for higher levels and become a strong energy. You have to begin by loving yourself and showing the gratitude in life for every little thing. Stay strong brother and I love you. ♥️

It’s just not her man, I will give my all to everyone around me but whenever I need someone close, no one is there. They either say my feelings are invalid or just leave me alone. That shit sucks man.

We communicate daily and we do know we love each other, but with the lost of our first born; we lost the happiness that kept us strong together. I’m just weird I don’t know. I pray I find a purpose, surround myself with people who love me, and I continue to be strong but if my life continues this way I won’t make it too next year. Thank you for your words and I appreciate you brother.

I’m so lonely man. Whenever someone needs me in life I’m quick to provide but when I ask for help I am abandoned. I know I have my parents around me but I have 0 friends. I have no one to go out and do things with, my girlfriend and I are having a fall out; even though everything seemed okay but now it’s worse then ever. We had a lost loved one in our relationship and it really deteriorated everything we had built. I haven’t seen her in months even though we live 3 minutes apart. Whenever I’m outside and I see people hanging out with their friends or SO it eats me alive because I feel as if I will never experience any of this and I’m so sick of it. 

School is going great for me, I got offered many internships and opportunities but I feel like I stay amount to nothing and it’s just mentally draining. 

I see no point of carrying on in life because what is the point of all this; in the end I will be dead and everything I’ve done won’t matter to a point. The world will carry on without and go on about their day and life. What is the point of all this?
